analysis: Examined base-text units for docs/provider/cli-reference.md lines 805-1726 (Autopilot enrollment, beta, fan, idle, addon hold, stop/restart, status, doctor, verify, models, benchmark, update, login/logout, enroll/unenroll, logs, report). These lines are unchanged per the complete range map; the only change is head line 1960, which adds a documentation row for DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE_SSD_INCREMENTAL_CHECKPOINTS, citing SSDPrefixCachePolicy.swift (incrementalCheckpoints), where a negative value writes complete checkpoints instead of deltas. This is documentation only and changes no control. It is relevant to T-041/SEC-035 because the threat model's detection_hint covers DBK3 metadata, AAD, TTL, disk budget and donation gating. Incremental (delta) checkpoints may alter the at-rest artifact shape, write volume and disk-budget interaction. The doc row alone does not establish any weakening: the HMAC names, TTL and kill switch are not described as changed. Integration should confirm whether the PR also modifies SSDPrefixCachePolicy.swift or the SSD block store/metadata to implement delta checkpoints. If so, reviewers should check that delta files keep HMAC-only names, keep prompt-derived data out of AAD/metadata, keep the 30-min TTL and disk-budget accounting, and preserve AES-GCM authentication for chained deltas, plus fail-closed behavior on a missing base checkpoint. If those source changes exist, T-041 may need updating to describe the incremental checkpoint format. No regression identified from the supplied evidence.
